screen.title: Library loan policy
text: Effective March 1, the main library will replace its fixed loan periods with a demand-based system. Items with no waiting list will renew automatically up to five times, so most borrowers will no longer need to visit the desk. However, once another user places a hold on an item you have borrowed, your loan will be shortened to seven days, and you will receive an email with the new due date. Overdue fines are being abolished; instead, borrowing privileges will be suspended until held items are returned. Laptops and other equipment remain excluded from the new system.

questions.stem: What is the main change described in the notice?
options: Borrowers must now renew every item at the front desk
How long people keep items will depend on whether others want them
The library will begin charging higher fines for all late returns of books
Laptops may now be borrowed for longer periods

why.en: Main change (paraphrase): the loan period depends on demand. A and C contradict the text; D is equipment that is excluded.
why.tr: Ana değişiklik (parafraz): süre talebe bağlı. A ve C metnin tersi; D hariç tutulan ekipman.
why.es: Cambio principal (paráfrasis): el plazo de préstamo depende de la demanda. A y C contradicen el texto; D es material que queda excluido.

questions.stem: What will most likely happen to a student who keeps a requested book past its new due date?
options: The loan will renew automatically up to five times.
The student will have to pay a small fine for each extra day it is late.
The student will be unable to borrow anything else for a while.
The library will send the book to the other user.

why.en: Inference: borrowing rights are suspended instead of a fine. B is the old rule that was removed; A applies to books with no waiting list.
why.tr: Çıkarım: ceza yerine ödünç alma hakkı askıya alınır. B kaldırılan eski kural; A bekleme listesi olmayan kitaplar için.
why.es: Inferencia: se suspende el derecho de préstamo en lugar de poner una multa. B es la norma antigua que se eliminó; A se aplica a los libros sin lista de espera.

questions.stem: Which items are NOT covered by the new system?

why.en: Detail/paraphrase: laptops and other equipment → equipment such as computers.
why.tr: Detay/parafraz: laptops and other equipment → bilgisayar gibi ekipman.
why.es: Detalle/paráfrasis: laptops and other equipment → material como ordenadores.
